versions.content: Support of DTCExtendedDataRecordNumber 0xFE The Dem shall always support DTCExtendedDataRecordNumber 0xFE for the primary fault memory in case at least one extended data record in the range 0x90-0x9F is supported (which means regulatory emission OBD is used) and return all regulated emission OBD stored extended data records in the range of 0x90 to 0x9F.
